translations.web: but into the second the high priest alone, once in the year, not without blood, which he offers for himself, and for the errors of the people.
translations.bsb: But only the high priest entered the second room, and then only once a year, and never without blood, which he offered for himself and for the sins the people had committed in ignorance.
